title: Dag and Flow Ui Theme Sync
description: DAG and Flow canvases use hardcoded dark colors and do not respect UI light/dark theme. Wire VelloThemePalette from CSS tokens like puzzle2d/map.
summary: DAG and Flow canvases now respect UI light/dark theme. React hosts use `bg-canvas` and sync `serializeGraphVelloThemePaletteJson()` from `@semio-tech/ui-styling` into WASM each frame. Rust hosts paint from `VelloThemePalette` instead of hardcoded dark colors.
